Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 0px padding and a 0px radius. Drive the shell with repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(15, 23, 42) 0px, rgb(15, 23, 42) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 8px) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame. 表面样例 Glass 边框、阴影与模糊处理按生成的层次体系预览。 Surface Glass Border 1px #0F172A Shadow rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05) 0px 25px 50px -12px Blur 12px 形状 Shapes rely on a tight radius system anchored by 2px and scaled across cards, buttons, and supporting surfaces. Icon geometry should stay compatible with that soft-to-controlled silhouette. 圆角族 2px9999px 图标集 Solar 主圆角 2px 图标风格 线性 图标集 Solar 规范与禁忌 遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。 建议 • 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。 • keep spacing aligned to the detected 8px rhythm. • 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。 • keep corner radii within the detected 2px, 9999px family. 避免 • 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。 • 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。 • 没有明确理由时，不要超过检测到的极简动效强度。 动效 动效保持克制，以界面为主导，覆盖文字、布局与滚动过渡。 缓动偏好 Ease。 滚动编排采用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。 动效强度 极简 缓动 Ease 滚动模式 GSAP ScrollTrigger 60 FPS 示例过渡 · 300ms WebGL WebGL Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using alpha, antialias, custom shaders. The effect should read as retro-futurist, technical, and meditative: dot-matrix particle field with green on black and sparse spacing. Build it from dot particles + soft depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve reduced motion + dom fallback. 技术栈 WebGL 场景 全出血背景场 效果 点阵粒子场 图元 点粒子 + 柔和景深衰减 动效 缓慢呼吸脉冲 交互 指针响应式漂移 渲染 alpha, antialias, custom shaders 技法 点阵呼吸脉冲指针视差着色器渐变噪点场 代码参考 HTML 参考 html
